---
# Survey configuration.
# All available settings are documented at https://surveydown.org
# and listed in _survey/settings.yml after the first render.
#
# Built after gitklar-dev/pre-course-survey and agentsforsci-dev/pre-course-survey
# (2026-11-09). Course Git for Scientists, iteration gitforsci-rdc (Research
# Data Conference 2026, Bern).

theme-settings:
  theme: [litera, custom.scss]
  barposition: top
  barcolor: "#0F4C81"
  footer-left: "Lars Schöbitz, Global Health Engineering, ETH Zurich. Made with [surveydown](https://surveydown.org), licensed [CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)"
  footer-right: "[Source code](https://github.com/gitforsci-dev/pre-course-survey)"

survey-settings:
  # "preview" saves test answers to preview_data.csv (git-ignored).
  # Switch to "database" only after the Supabase table is set up (README).
  mode: database
  show-previous: true
  use-cookies: true
  auto-scroll: false
  rate-survey: false
  system-language: en
  highlight-unanswered: false
  highlight-color: blue
  # false: no browser string and no IP address are stored with a response
  capture-metadata: false
  # Questions are listed one by one rather than with all-required, so that
  # text fields shown with sd_show_if() are only enforced while visible
  # (see the surveydown gotchas), and the matrix prog is listed by its
  # parent id. ai_tools and teaching_context are optional.
  all-required: false
  required:
    - consent
    - email
    - github_account
    - github_username
    - github_username_new
    - os
    - os_other
    - install_rights
    - role
    - role_other
    - teaches_git
    - rdm_level
    - rdm_level_other
    - rdm_activities
    - installed
    - git_today
    - preferred_setup
    - ai_tools_other
    - prog
    - cli_usage
    - git_experience
    - learning_goals
---

```{r}
library(surveydown)

# Cohort values. Edit these for the next iteration of the workshop.
workshop_name <- "Git for Scientists"
event         <- "Research Data Conference 2026 in Bern"
workshop_date <- "Friday, 20 November 2026, 09:30 to 11:30"
survey_due    <- "Friday, 13 November 2026"
steps_date    <- "Monday, 16 November 2026"
website_url   <- "https://gitforsci-rdc.github.io/website/"
instructor    <- "Lars Schöbitz"
organiser     <- "Global Health Engineering, ETH Zurich"
contact       <- "lschoebitz@ethz.ch"
delete_by     <- "20 November 2027"
```

--- start

# `r workshop_name` at RDC 2026: pre-course survey

Thank you for joining the workshop "`r workshop_name`" at the `r event`, on `r workshop_date`.

This survey is step 1 of the pre-course work. It takes 10 to 15 minutes. Please complete it by `r survey_due`.

Your answers decide which software we use for the hands-on part, and they shape the day. The setup instructions follow on the workshop website on `r steps_date`: [`r website_url`](`r website_url`)

Questions? Write to `r contact`.

`r instructor`, `r organiser`

--- agreement

## Your consent

```{r}
sd_question(
  type   = "mc",
  id     = "consent",
  label  = paste0(
    "I agree that my answers, my email address and my GitHub username are used to plan and run this workshop. ",
    "Only the course instructor has access to them. The survey runs on Posit Connect Cloud, the answers are stored in a database in Zurich (Supabase), ",
    "and they are shared with no one else. ",
    "My GitHub username is used to invite me to the course organisation on GitHub. ",
    "My email address is used only for this workshop and deleted at the latest one year after the conference (", delete_by, "). ",
    "Without email address and username, the answers may be used to improve the workshop and in reports about it; ",
    "only aggregated results are published, never individual answers. ",
    "I can withdraw my consent at any time by email to ", contact, "."
  ),
  option = c("Yes, I agree" = "yes")
)
```

--- about

## About you

```{r}
sd_question(
  type  = "text",
  id    = "email",
  label = paste0(
    "Your email address<br>",
    "*I use it to send you the setup instructions on ", steps_date, ", and for nothing else.*"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type   = "mc",
  id     = "github_account",
  label  = "Do you have a GitHub account?",
  option = c(
    "Yes"          = "yes",
    "No"           = "no",
    "I don't know" = "dont_know"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type  = "text",
  id    = "github_username",
  label = "Your GitHub username<br>*Without the @. You find it at the top right of github.com when you are signed in.*"
)

# Shown for "No" and "I don't know": the account is created during the
# survey, so every respondent leaves a username behind.
sd_question(
  type  = "text",
  id    = "github_username_new",
  label = paste0(
    "**Create your GitHub account now and enter the username here.**<br>",
    "*I invite you to the course organisation on GitHub before the workshop, so I need your username. It takes about five minutes. ",
    "Not sure whether you already have an account? Try to sign in first at ",
    "<a href='https://github.com/login' target='_blank'>github.com/login</a>. ",
    "If it works, enter the name shown at the top right.*<br>",
    "1. Open <a href='https://github.com/signup' target='_blank'>github.com/signup</a> in a new tab.<br>",
    "2. Enter an email address you will keep and choose a password.<br>",
    "3. Choose a username made of letters, digits and hyphens, no spaces. ",
    "It is public, for example in the address of your projects. Many people use firstname-lastname.<br>",
    "4. Confirm your email address with the code GitHub sends you.<br>",
    "5. Come back here and enter the username below, without the @.<br>",
    "*No time right now? Leave this window open or come back later in the same browser. Your answers so far stay saved.*"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type   = "mc",
  id     = "os",
  label  = "Which operating system is on the laptop you bring to the workshop?",
  option = c(
    "macOS (Apple)" = "macos",
    "Windows"       = "windows",
    "Linux"         = "linux",
    "Another one"   = "other",
    "I don't know"  = "dont_know"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type  = "text",
  id    = "os_other",
  label = "Which other operating system?"
)

sd_question(
  type   = "mc",
  id     = "install_rights",
  label  = "Can you install software on that laptop yourself?<br>*For example R, RStudio or GitHub Desktop, without asking your IT department.*",
  option = c(
    "Yes"                                   = "yes",
    "No, our IT department installs software for me" = "no_it",
    "I don't know"                          = "dont_know"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type   = "mc",
  id     = "role",
  label  = "What is your role?",
  option = c(
    "Data steward or research data manager" = "data_steward",
    "Research software engineer"            = "rse",
    "Librarian"                             = "librarian",
    "Researcher"                            = "researcher",
    "Lecturer or trainer"                   = "trainer",
    "IT"                                    = "it",
    "Another role"                          = "other"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type  = "text",
  id    = "role_other",
  label = "Which other role?"
)

sd_question(
  type   = "mc",
  id     = "teaches_git",
  label  = "Do you teach Git and GitHub, or plan to?",
  option = c(
    "Yes, I teach it"       = "teach",
    "I plan to"             = "plan",
    "No"                    = "no"
  )
)
```

--- rdm

## Your work with research data

```{r}
sd_question(
  type   = "mc",
  id     = "rdm_level",
  label  = "Where does your work with research data sit?",
  option = c(
    "Embedded in one research group (a data steward or similar role inside the group)" = "group",
    "A service for one department or institute (several research groups)"              = "department",
    "A central service of the institution (library, IT, research support office)"      = "central",
    "Across institutions (a network, a national service, an infrastructure provider)"  = "cross_institution",
    "Informal: I help colleagues with their data, it is not my role"                   = "informal",
    "I am a researcher managing my own data"                                           = "own_data",
    "Somewhere else"                                                                   = "other"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type  = "text",
  id    = "rdm_level_other",
  label = "Where else?"
)

sd_question(
  type   = "mc_multiple",
  id     = "rdm_activities",
  label  = "Which of these are part of your work with research data? (several answers possible)",
  option = c(
    "Data management plans"                  = "dmp",
    "Training and courses"                   = "training",
    "One to one consulting"                  = "consulting",
    "Data publishing and repositories"       = "publishing",
    "Documentation and curation"             = "curation",
    "Metadata and standards"                 = "metadata",
    "Storage and infrastructure"             = "infrastructure",
    "Policy and strategy"                    = "policy",
    "Software and tooling"                   = "software",
    "None of these"                          = "none"
  )
)
```

--- tools

## Your tools today

```{r}
sd_question(
  type   = "mc_multiple",
  id     = "installed",
  label  = "Which of these are installed on the laptop you bring? (several answers possible)",
  option = c(
    "R"                        = "r",
    "RStudio"                  = "rstudio",
    "Positron"                 = "positron",
    "Visual Studio Code"       = "vscode",
    "Git on the command line"  = "git_cli",
    "GitHub Desktop"           = "github_desktop",
    "Python"                   = "python",
    "None of these"            = "none",
    "I don't know"             = "dont_know"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type   = "mc_multiple",
  id     = "git_today",
  label  = "How do you work with Git today, if at all? (several answers possible)",
  option = c(
    "On the command line"             = "cli",
    "In the RStudio Git pane"         = "rstudio_pane",
    "In GitHub Desktop"               = "github_desktop",
    "In Visual Studio Code"           = "vscode",
    "In another Git app (for example GitKraken, Sourcetree)" = "other_app",
    "Only on the GitHub website"      = "web_only",
    "Not at all"                      = "not_at_all"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type   = "mc",
  id     = "preferred_setup",
  label  = paste0(
    "If the choice were yours, which setup would you prefer for the hands-on part?<br>",
    "*Each has its own pre-work. RStudio with Git needs R, RStudio and Git installed. ",
    "GitHub Desktop needs one app and no R. ",
    "Positron is Posit's new editor; it needs R, Positron and Git.*"
  ),
  option = c(
    "RStudio with Git"  = "rstudio",
    "GitHub Desktop"    = "github_desktop",
    "Positron"          = "positron",
    "No preference"     = "no_preference"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type   = "mc_multiple",
  id     = "ai_tools",
  label  = "Which AI tools have you used? (several answers possible, optional)",
  option = c(
    "ChatGPT (OpenAI)"                                  = "chatgpt",
    "Codex (OpenAI)"                                    = "codex",
    "Claude (Anthropic)"                                = "claude",
    "Claude Code (Anthropic)"                           = "claude_code",
    "Gemini (Google)"                                   = "gemini",
    "Microsoft Copilot (in Windows, Edge, Teams or Microsoft 365)" = "copilot_365",
    "GitHub Copilot (in VS Code, RStudio or Positron)"  = "copilot_ide",
    "Cursor"                                            = "cursor",
    "Positron Assistant"                                = "positron_assistant",
    "Local models (for example Ollama, LM Studio)"      = "local_models",
    "Other"                                             = "other",
    "None of the above"                                 = "none"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type  = "text",
  id    = "ai_tools_other",
  label = "Other AI tool (please specify):"
)
```

--- experience

## Your experience

```{r}
sd_question(
  type   = "matrix",
  id     = "prog",
  label  = "How much programming experience do you have?",
  row    = c(
    "Programming in general" = "general",
    "Programming in R"       = "r",
    "Programming in Python"  = "python"
  ),
  option = c(
    "I have none"                                   = "none",
    "I have written a few lines"                    = "few_lines",
    "I have written programs for my own use"        = "own_use",
    "I have written and maintained larger software" = "maintained"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type   = "mc",
  id     = "cli_usage",
  label  = "Which of these best describes your use of the command line?<br>*On a Mac the app is called Terminal. On Windows it is Windows Terminal or PowerShell.*",
  option = c(
    "I have never used the command line."                                                       = "never",
    "Occasionally, for basic tasks (for example copying a command from an instruction)."         = "occasional",
    "Regularly, for my own projects, including scripts."                                        = "regular",
    "Extensively, for advanced workflows (for example SSH, environments, custom scripts)."      = "extensive"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type   = "mc",
  id     = "git_experience",
  label  = "Which of these best describes your experience with Git?<br>*Git records every version of your files, so that you can trace and undo changes.*",
  option = c(
    "I have never used Git"                    = "never",
    "Occasionally, for first steps"            = "occasional",
    "Regularly, for my own projects"           = "regular",
    "Extensively, also together with others"   = "extensive"
  )
)
```

--- goals

## Your goals for the workshop

```{r}
sd_question(
  type  = "textarea",
  id    = "learning_goals",
  label = "What do you want to know or be able to do after this workshop that you don't know or can't do right now?"
)

sd_question(
  type  = "textarea",
  id    = "teaching_context",
  label = "If you teach or plan to teach Git and GitHub: who are your learners, and in which setting? (optional)<br>*The second half of the workshop looks at the material through an educator's eyes. Your answer helps me prepare that part.*"
)
```

--- end

## Thank you

Your answers are saved. The setup instructions appear on the workshop website on `r steps_date`: [`r website_url`](`r website_url`). I also send them to the email address you gave. You can close this window now.

```{r}
sd_close()
```
